title: Keep Your Pieces Safe

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Helmet fitted. I am ready for the safety round.
directions: [board: two quiz podiums, lettered D THREE and D TWO. Pip stands at the wrong one, wearing a helmet, one hand on a buzzer.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The helmet is not defense. This video has no answer timer. Take your time.
directions: [board: Click lifts the buzzer off the desk and shuts it in a drawer.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Then I will answer slowly. Helmet on.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: From the drawer. Proposal: the helmet counts as defense. Overruled. The card says one.
directions: [board: the drawer marked PIP'S AMENDMENTS (PENDING) opens. One card comes out.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Hello. Somebody wants our Hi.
directions: [board: White Hi on D four. Black Sjor on D seven. Sign: only this Sjor can reach the Hi. Both banks empty.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Sjor's speed is one. One square, one action.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Sjor's attack is two. Water beats Fire, so add one. That makes three.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Three damage against defense one. A hit removes the Hi.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Then the Hi steps back one square, to D three.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Sjor cannot stand on our Hi. It must stop next door, on D four.
directions: [board: a ghost Hi shows D three. The Sjor's path lights up square by square, down to D four.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That trip is three squares. Three squares is three actions.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Then the hit. Four.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Four is their whole turn. It fits.
directions: [card: A DANGER IS A TRIP PLUS A HIT · both come out of the same four]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Count their trip. Then count their hit.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Their whole turn: four actions.
directions: [board: the ghost clears. The Hi slides from D four to D two in one trip. The podium cards stay lit: D THREE, four actions. D TWO, a question mark.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Hitting the Hi on D three would take all four.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the Hi stands on D two. Can this Sjor reach it and hit it?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Say it, point at a podium, or take the time and say nothing.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: To hit D two, the Sjor must stand on D three. That trip is four squares.
directions: [sfx: piece step] [board: the Sjor walks from D seven down to D three, four squares. The action tray empties. The hit never happens.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Sjor arrived beside it, with no action left to attack. So: no.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The hit would be a fifth action. There is no fifth action.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Name for the file: the Missing Fifth.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Our Hi has speed two. D four to D two was one trip, one action.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The counting did it. The helmet has filed a complaint.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The Sjor is standing on D three now. Next turn it is one action away.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Four squares. Speed two. Two actions, then the hit. Three.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE · safe from: this Sjor, this turn, checked · every other enemy: not checked · Black's crystals: not checked]
[card: PODIUM THREE · the same squares · a visitor with speed two]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: So D two was never the safe part. The Sjor's speed was.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: One to ask whoever plays with you. Which retreat would you pick, and why?
directions: [card: TABLE TASK · walk their nearest piece toward yours with a finger · count out loud · stop at four]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Count their trip. Then count their hit. The buzzer stays in the drawer.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Today was plenty. Next time, a clock that resets only when an attack removes an enemy.

question: Now the Hi stands on D two. Can this Sjor reach it and hit it?
